## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_refiner_rank_384_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3 Draft and Final
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This workflow makes a quick **draft** of a shot, then **finishes** a draft you like at full size. Finishing does not render the shot again: it refines the draft itself, so the final keeps the draft's motion, framing and sound.

**Generate**

- The **Image to Video** task of the official template (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo`): text to video, or with an optional **first_frame** and **last_frame**
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. **duration (seconds)** is converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping to the model's 17k+5 grid at 24fps

**Finish a draft**

- **Draft to finish** takes the draft video. It is scaled to the final size, encoded with its sound, re-noised from sigma 0.8 and refined in three Euler steps with the Open-H3-Regenerate refiner LoRA, the way NVIDIA's Open-H3-Regenerate-2K does. The sound is kept as it is
- **If/Else Switch (Draft or final)** saves the refined video instead of a new one

**In Spool**

Spool fills this in. **Draft** renders at **Draft resolution** with Turbo on; **Make final** on a draft take loads that take into **Draft to finish** and renders at **Final resolution**. Without a draft, Spool leaves the finish out and generates.

Opened in ComfyUI on its own, the workflow finishes the video in **Draft to finish**. To generate a new shot there, use the MiniMax H3 Image to Video template.

nodes.title: Note: Finish a draft
widgets_values:
## Finish a draft

1. **Draft to finish**: the draft, with its sound
2. **Draft at the final size**: scaled to the Resolution Selector's size
3. **Encode**: picture and sound into one latent; a mask of 0 keeps the sound as it is
4. **Refine from the draft**: sigmas `0.8, 0.738462, 0.6, 0` with `euler`, on the model with the Open-H3-Regenerate refiner LoRA. A higher first sigma redraws more and drifts from the draft
5. **Final with the draft's sound**: the refined picture with the draft's own sound
